profile_name: Plumber / Sanitary & Heating Technician (SHK) - Klarwasser SHK Technik GmbH, Berlin (case study, profile v1 pilot)

company.name: Klarwasser SHK Technik GmbH, Berlin
company.summary: A Berlin plumbing and heating contractor serving residential and commercial customers across the city: installation and modernisation of bathrooms, drinking-water and drainage systems, condensing boilers and heat pumps, plus a 24/7 emergency callout service. Its service crews work at customer sites in two-person teams and represent the company directly in front of the customer.
company.values_text: safety; quality craftsmanship; reliable service; customer care; teamwork

job.title: Plumber / Sanitary & Heating Technician (SHK)
job.description: You will install and service drinking-water, drainage and heating systems at customer sites in two-person teams, carry out bathroom renovations and boiler service calls, detect and repair leaks, take part in the on-call and emergency rotation, and represent the company in front of customers. The eligibility requirements follow the standard published for comparable service-plumber and Anlagenmechaniker SHK positions (including German Anlagenmechaniker SHK postings on the Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit job board and standard English-language service-plumber postings, retrieved 2026-11-11): completed vocational training as Anlagenmechaniker SHK or plumber, proven installation experience in sanitary and heating systems, a valid class B driver's licence, good German for customer-facing work and participation in the on-call rotation.

certifications.skill: vocational qualification in the plumbing/SHK trade
